posts.title: Buying guide

slides.headline: How to spot a real Alphonso
Smell the stem
slides.body: A real Alphonso smells sweet and floral at the stem, even before it is fully ripe.

slides.headline: Check the shape
slides.body: Look for a rounded, slightly oval mango with a small beak near the stem.

slides.headline: Press gently
slides.body: It should give a little, like a ripe peach. Very soft spots mean it is past its best.

caption.default: Not every mango sold as Alphonso is one. Swipe for three quick checks.
caption.x: Three quick checks to spot a real Alphonso.
